scripts.sass: _DIR="$PWD/assets" && if [[ ! -f $_DIR/js/sveltle.css ]]; then touch $_DIR/js/svelte.css; fi; if [[ ! -L $_DIR/styles/sass/_svelte.css ]]; then ln -s $_DIR/js/svelte.css $_DIR/styles/sass/_svelte.css; fi; sass assets/styles/sass/:assets/styles/
scripts.sass:watch: _DIR="$PWD/assets" && if [[ ! -f $_DIR/js/sveltle.css ]]; then touch $_DIR/js/svelte.css; fi; if [[ ! -L $_DIR/styles/sass/_svelte.css ]]; then ln -s $_DIR/js/svelte.css $_DIR/styles/sass/_svelte.css; fi; sass assets/styles/sass/:assets/styles/ -w
scripts.build: pnpm run ts; pnpm run sass
